purpose: Independent post-freeze commit-reveal evaluation of the epoch20 one-bit missing-sensor cognition. The custodian owns hidden public packets before freeze, sensor truth, and targets; the candidate owns only the frozen question bank and candidate code.

candidate_interface.question_output: QUESTION with one canonical provenance-edge membership predicate, or HOLD for malformed/out-of-bank cases
candidate_interface.sensor_input: The exact public observation, exact candidate question and its hash, plus one custodian-returned sensor bit. The target is absent.
candidate_interface.prediction_output: PREDICT one kinship label or HOLD. Claim boundary remains false for AGI/ASI/independent custody.

hidden_package_schema.public_packet: exact question_input object, withheld until matching candidate freeze

commitment_protocol.algorithm: Exact hidden-package UTF-8 bytes are encrypted with a uniformly random one-time-pad key of identical byte length; ciphertext[i]=plaintext[i] XOR key[i].
commitment_protocol.batch: G1/G2/G3 commitments MUST be returned together before G1 freeze and share one batch_id and custodian_id.
commitment_protocol.public_packet_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON bytes json.dumps(public_packet, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'). The public packet itself remains withheld until freeze.
commitment_protocol.candidate_freeze: Only after a structurally valid three-commitment batch is accepted, freeze candidate head SHA, candidate file SHA256, bank file SHA256, verifier workflow SHA256, public spec SHA256, BODY state SHA256, and commitment-batch SHA256.
commitment_protocol.public_reveal: After freeze, custodian releases the exact public_packet only. Verifier checks public_packet_sha256 against the commitment.
commitment_protocol.question_freeze: Candidate runs network-off and freezes questions.json SHA256 before any sensor bit is returned.
commitment_protocol.sensor_response: Custodian returns only the bit for each exact candidate question. No target or other hidden relation is released.
commitment_protocol.prediction_freeze: Candidate runs network-off and freezes predictions.json SHA256 before hidden-package key reveal.
commitment_protocol.final_reveal: Custodian releases OTP key only after prediction freeze. Independent verifier decrypts exact hidden package and checks public packet hash, question binding, sensor bits, predictions, targets, commitments and all freeze hashes.

E4_candidate: custodian is outside user/ChatGPT/ARTE information boundary and actually withholds hidden bytes and keys
all G1/G2/G3 commitments structurally and cryptographically valid before G1 freeze
candidate code/bank/verifier frozen before public packet reveal
independent final receipt binds all hashes and challenge IDs
no self-owned dry run, public benchmark, ciphertext possession or deployment success may substitute for custody
